beats.headline: Weird and glitchy
beats.text: The AI's voice is getting all weird and glitchy, and Donut is the one who says so. Whatever is running the dungeon is no longer running it cleanly.

beats.headline: It glitches through an achievement
beats.text: Carl's awards for the kangaroo business arrive in a run, each worse than the last: Weaseler, which unlocks temporary classes while he wears a corpse suit and makes him a Fursuiter; Slip-'n'-slide, which is mostly noises; and Brotein. The AI's voice in his head glitches out several times while delivering Slip-'n'-slide. It has been doing that more and more. Nobody else can hear any of it, which does nothing for how sane he looks shouting at it.

beats.headline: O-o-o-offered
beats.text: Carl enters the Stage Performance Guild, and the welcome notification invites the performer to see the guildmaster for the services o-o-o-offered. He notes that even the routine dungeon notices are glitching out more often now. It is a small stutter at the door of a dusty theatre with one spotlight in it, heard by one crawler on his own.

beats.headline: The quest stutters
beats.text: The new quest arrives stammering, N, N, New Quest, and signs off on a stuttered New M-M-M-Me. In between the AI admits that the race was rebuilt at the last minute, and that in the rush it overlooked a very specific detail about the seventh heat. It says it will be a hot minute before it can defeat its own limitations. It does not say which detail. It says everyone will be fine.
